description: Upstream projects Flint ports (ADR-030 section 7). 'use' says how Flint may use each one: port-source (copy and translate, keeping the header and adding 'Modified by the Flint authors'), port-source-bsd-option (dual-licensed; Flint takes the BSD option), epl-module (port only into a module licensed EPL-2.0), clean-room (implement from specification and documentation; copy no code), native-c (linked as a pinned C dependency through native-lock.json). 'verified' is the date the licence was read from the upstream repository.

projects.name: openjdk
projects.evidence: LICENSE and ADDITIONAL_LICENSE_INFO at tag jdk-21.0.13-ga. Owner licensing rule (decisions.md, 2026-11-26 04:25Z): source may be ported, including jtreg tests, only into dedicated -openjdk packages whose dub.sdl declares license "GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0", which keep the exception and never mix with Apache-derived files. Every ported file must carry the Classpath exception: a file under plain GPL-2.0 (many jtreg tests carry no exception) may not be ported. The Java SE 21 API manifest stays signatures only (include = exported java/javax roots of java.base and java.sql).

projects.name: aspectj
projects.evidence: LICENSE-AspectJ.adoc and licenses/LICENSE-EPL-2.0.txt in aspectjrt-1.9.27-sources.jar; the POM names EPL-2.0 (archive SHA-1 matches Maven Central). The version Spring v7.1.0 pins (framework-platform). Owner decision 2026-11-26: EPL-2.0 is acceptable, so source may be ported, but only into its own module whose dub.sdl declares license "EPL-2.0" (like jakarta-annotation); the API scope is org.aspectj.lang (api/upstreams.json include).

projects.name: harmony
projects.header: Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF)
projects.evidence: LICENSE in apache-harmony-6.0-src-r991881-snapshot.tar.gz (Apache License 2.0; archive SHA-1 bf426793 matches Apache's .sha). Port only files under classlib/ that carry the ASF header, and ship the archive root's NOTICE (Apache-2.0 section 4(d)) in each module that ports from it, as NOTICE.md; the bundled third-party components listed after the licence keep their own terms and are not ported. Roughly Java 6: the API inventory is the Java SE 21 manifest (openjdk), so the pin is api:false (docs/spring/phase2/jdk-port.md).
